searchText: I think there is a bug in your implemenation <@!636906092374261761> You forgot to return the actual value of the gas pool for block before eip-1559 fork You should add a return here: https://github.com/vulcanize/go-ethereum/blob/ac476314a79a40d9ba04d8ff9cbc10e231a4c0e7/core/gaspool.go#L36 I think this commit introduced the bug: https://github.com/vulcanize/go-ethereum/commit/0027f1d966297089c04e38ab6e65ab5ec3e4a5aa I deployed a Geth node with the fix and it works. The synchronisation is in progress. The Geth node is listed in the Eth Stats: http://3.21.227.120:3001/ It is listed as `cs-geth-rhodes-1` <@!636906092374261761> , <@!489256758989029405> please can you always add your nodes to the eth stats for visibility Consensus Besu<>Geth is ok with my fix. <@!489256758989029405> any update on Nethermind side ? Hi <@!574864862338088960> thank you for bug report. We are fixing it now and adding unit test to cover this test case yes, I am working on it ok cool
